title: Paperless-ngx Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for the Paperless-ngx Helm chart with PostgreSQL, Valkey, persistent storage, and optional Tika/Gotenberg.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full release name used in resource names

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every resource created by this chart

replicaCount.description: Number of Paperless-ngx replicas. Only 0 or 1 is supported because the scheduler and consumer must run once.

strategy.description: Deployment update strategy. Defaults to Recreate because the data and media PVCs are ReadWriteOnce and two Paperless-ngx instances must never run against the same data at the same time.

tag.description: Paperless-ngx image tag. Defaults to appVersion validated on GitHub Releases and GHCR.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries

url.description: Public URL of Paperless-ngx without trailing slash. Sets ALLOWED_HOSTS, CORS and CSRF origins. Auto-detected from the first ingress host or gateway hostname when empty.

secretKey.description: Secret key used to sign sessions and tokens. Auto-generated if empty.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the secret key. Takes precedence over secretKey, and stops the chart from creating or rotating one, which matters for GitOps renderers where the cluster lookup is unavailable.

existingSecretSecretKeyKey.description: Secret key for the secret key value in paperless.existingSecret

timeZone.description: Time zone used for dates and scheduled tasks

ocrLanguage.description: Default OCR language (Tesseract code). The image ships eng, deu, ita, spa and fra; combine with "+", for example deu+eng.

enabled.description: Create a superuser on startup. Paperless-ngx never changes an existing user's password.

email.description: Superuser email address. Upstream defaults to root@localhost when empty.

password.description: Superuser password. Auto-generated if empty. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret containing the superuser password

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Secret key for the superuser password in paperless.admin.existingSecret

pollingInterval.description: Poll the consumption directory every N seconds. 0 uses inotify; set a positive value for NFS or SMB volumes.

recursive.description: Consume files in subdirectories of the consumption directory

extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables for the Paperless-ngx container

extraEnvFrom.description: Additional envFrom sources (ConfigMaps or Secrets) for the Paperless-ngx container

mode.description: Database mode: auto | external | postgresql | sqlite. auto picks external, then the subchart, then SQLite.

password.description: External PostgreSQL password. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret containing the external PostgreSQL password

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Secret key for the external PostgreSQL password

options.description: Advanced driver options passed as PAPERLESS_DB_OPTIONS, for example "sslmode=require,pool.max_size=5"

enabled.description: Deploy the HelmForge Valkey subchart. Disable when using valkey.external.*

architecture.description: Valkey subchart architecture: standalone | replication. Use valkey.external.* for sentinel or cluster.

password.description: External Valkey password. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret containing the external Valkey password

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Secret key for the external Valkey password

prefix.description: Key and channel prefix in Valkey. Useful when several Paperless-ngx instances share one Valkey.

enabled.description: Create a PVC for /usr/src/paperless/data (search index, classifier, SQLite database). Uses emptyDir when disabled.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC for the data directory

storageClass.description: Storage class for the data PVC

accessMode.description: Access mode for the data PVC

enabled.description: Create a PVC for /usr/src/paperless/media (original and archived documents). Uses emptyDir when disabled.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC for the media directory

storageClass.description: Storage class for the media PVC

accessMode.description: Access mode for the media PVC

enabled.description: Create a PVC for /usr/src/paperless/consume (watched input folder). Uses emptyDir when disabled.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC for the consumption directory, for example a shared scanner volume

storageClass.description: Storage class for the consume PVC

accessMode.description: Access mode for the consume PVC

enabled.description: Create a PVC for /usr/src/paperless/export (document_exporter target). Uses emptyDir when disabled.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC for the export directory

storageClass.description: Storage class for the export PVC

accessMode.description: Access mode for the export PVC

enabled.description: Deploy Apache Tika. Must be enabled together with gotenberg.enabled; sets PAPERLESS_TIKA_ENABLED.

tag.description: Apache Tika image tag, matching the upstream Paperless-ngx compose files

resources.description: CPU and memory requests/limits for Tika

enabled.description: Deploy Gotenberg. Must be enabled together with tika.enabled.

tag.description: Gotenberg image tag, matching the upstream Paperless-ngx compose files

args.description: Gotenberg arguments. The defaults match upstream and block JavaScript and external content in emails.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests/limits for Gotenberg

type.description: Service type for the Paperless-ngx HTTP service

port.description: Service port exposed by the Paperless-ngx service

ipFamilyPolicy.description: Service IP family policy: SingleStack | PreferDualStack | RequireDualStack. Empty uses cluster default.

ipFamilies.description: Service IP families override. Empty uses cluster default.

annotations.description: Ingress annotations. Large uploads may need a body size annotation for your controller.

enabled.description: Enable startup probe. The first start runs database migrations and can take several minutes.

path.description: HTTP path used by the startup probe

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay before the first probe, in seconds. Paperless-ngx needs about 40 seconds for its s6 init before it listens, so earlier probes only produce Unhealthy events.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe fails

path.description: HTTP path used by the liveness probe

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay before the first probe, in seconds

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe fails

path.description: HTTP path used by the readiness probe

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay before the first probe, in seconds

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe fails

resources.description: CPU and memory requests/limits for the Paperless-ngx container. OCR of large documents is memory intensive.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context. Paperless-ngx 3.x supports running rootless with any UID/GID.

resources.description: Resources for wait-for-postgresql and wait-for-valkey init containers

securityContext.description: Security context for wait-for-postgresql and wait-for-valkey init containers

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period for shutdown, in seconds. Leaves running consume tasks time to finish.

podLabels.description: Additional labels for the Paperless-ngx pod

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations for the Paperless-ngx pod

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the Paperless-ngx container

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes for the Paperless-ngx pod

extraManifests.description: Extra Kubernetes manifests to deploy alongside the chart

enabled.description: Enable Gateway API HTTPRoute for Paperless-ngx HTTP (requires Gateway API CRDs)
Render an ExternalSecret for the external database password. Requires database.external.existingSecret to be set to prevent drift between the chart-managed Secret and the ExternalSecret.

creationPolicy.description: Creation policy for the target Secret

data.description: Data entries mapping remote keys to secret keys
